name: l3-archspec-generator
description: Generates L3 domain architecture specifications with the l3-domain-architecture-spec skill, using Claude models through GitHub Copilot.

l3spec.model.description: Copilot model to use (its id, family or name). Leave empty to use the first available Claude model. Use the 'L3 Spec Generator: Choose model' command to pick from the list.

l3spec.tools.enabled.description: Let the model find and call tools registered in VS Code (for example BAM or enterprise NFR standards MCP servers) while generating the specification.

l3spec.tools.allow.description: Optional: only offer MCP tools whose names match one of these regular expressions (for example "^mcp_bam_" or "nfr"). Leave empty to offer all MCP tools.

l3spec.tools.maxRounds.description: Maximum rounds of MCP tool calls in one generation step before the model must finish its reply.
